last.verdict: Refining windfall and a $20 billion 2027 buyback plan lifted shares.

reasons.label: Big refining rebound
reasons.text: Fuel-making profit more than doubled to $9.1 billion from $4.1 billion last quarter.

reasons.label: Huge 2027 buyback
reasons.text: Plans $20 billion of share repurchases in 2027, after $5.1 billion bought this quarter.

reasons.label: Strong cash, less debt
reasons.text: Free cash flow was $19.1 billion, and net debt fell by nearly $11 billion this year.

story: Profit stayed high through 2026, but oil output was flat near 4.5 million barrels a day and one-time items muddied results. Shares slipped 1.0% after July's small EPS miss, then rose 2.2% as refining profit jumped and a big buyback arrived.

history.verdict: Record profit and a small EPS miss left investors cautious; shares slipped.

reasons.label: Slight profit miss
reasons.text: Adjusted earnings of $3.52 a share came in below some analyst forecasts, about $3.60.

reasons.label: One-time hits
reasons.text: $2.6 billion of write-downs and other charges were partly offset by $2.5 billion of timing gains.

reasons.label: Flat oil output
reasons.text: Production was 4.51 million barrels a day, down from 4.59 million last quarter, despite a record Permian.
